mechanism: Train several CatBoost/RF regressors on random 50/50 splits; meta_labels = mean |y−ŷ| across models. Fit the final regressor only on rows with meta_labels < tol (e.g. 1e-2 or 1e-3 in price units). At inference require |meta_sig| < meta_threshold so trades open only when the causal residual filter says the magnitude forecast is trustworthy.
data_needed: Labeled future price change (or mean future close−current); shared multi-period features; tol and meta_threshold in price units.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train window ~2010–2024 with forward from 2024; periods [5,35,65,95] StdDev features.
why_new_for_mis: Turns prediction-error magnitude into an explicit reliability sensor that gates magnitude forecasts, unlike binary trade/no-trade meta-labels.
quote: the meta model will not predict 0 or 1 (trade or not trade), but the average values of deviations of forecasts from actual ones. This way we can filter out forecasts that deviate significantly from expected values.

mechanism: Label y = mean(close[i+min:i+max+1]) − close[i] instead of a single random future bar; regressors then predict averaged forward displacement so buy/sell thresholds (buy_threshold/sell_threshold) filter insignificant moves.
data_needed: Close series; horizon band min..max (article default 1..15 bars).
why_new_for_mis: Senses expected move size over a forward window rather than a single noisy future tick, enabling magnitude-aware regime/change filters.
quote: the function takes into account all deviations in the given interval, calculating the average value. After this, the difference between the average value of future prices and the current price is calculated.

mechanism: For each configured period, CopyClose then MathStandardDeviation(pr) into the ONNX feature vector (same periods for main and meta models).
data_needed: H1 closes over periods in {5,35,65,95} (article hyper_params).
why_new_for_mis: Compact multi-horizon realized-vol bank used both as primary features and as causal-meta inputs for MIS volatility sensing.

mechanism: PerfMeter CSV section timings and TestLite assertions for pure TradeMathCore helpers (pips/points, volume, stops, MA cross); developer diagnostics, not a market sensor.

mechanism: Build directed FX graph: vertices=currencies, buy edge weight=1/ask, sell edge weight=bid, edge cost=(ask−bid)/bid; drop pairs with spread_points > MaxSpreadPoints; profitable cycle iff product of weights − 1 − Σspreads > MinProfit.
data_needed: Live MqlTick bid/ask for a curated symbol list; SYMBOL_POINT; MaxSpreadPoints/MinProfit/MaxPathLength.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-pair Forex graph (≤25 currencies / ≤500 edges); tick-level rebuild; tester July–Sep 2025 with 80 ms delay.
why_new_for_mis: Joint liquidity+mispricing sensor: relative spreads and cycle net rate as a cross-pair inefficiency state, not single-symbol indicators.
quote: for a buy operation (transition from the base to the quote currency), the weight is 1/ask_price, for a sell operation (transition from the quote to the base currency), the weight is bid_price.

mechanism: Modified Floyd–Warshall maximizes rate products while accumulating spreads (update if new_rate > dist[i][j] and new_spread < spread_matrix[i][j]*2); diagonal dist[i][i]>1 flags cycles. Complementary AdvancedDFS enumerates cycles with no reused symbol, depth≤MaxPathLength, storing net_profit.
data_needed: Built Edge/Vertex arrays; MinProfit filter; optional ShowDetailedPaths.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same multi-currency FX book; analysis <100 ms claimed for 25×500 graphs.
why_new_for_mis: Operational cross-market cycle detector that surfaces when triangular/multi-leg FX pricing is inconsistent after costs.
quote: if(dist[i][i] > 1.0) { // Profitable cycle found double net_profit = dist[i][i] - 1.0 - spread_matrix[i][i];

mechanism: Build features: returns/log_returns; volatility_p and realized_vol_p for p∈{5,10,20,50} as rolling std×√24; RSI(7/14/21); MACD; momentum_10; fractal_dim via polyfit(log lags, log std of diffs) on 50-bar window (low≈trend, high≈chaos). Polynomial degree-2 expansion then Ridge/logistic → SymPy readable equation.
data_needed: OHLC closes; rolling windows; StandardScaler + PolynomialFeatures(degree=2).
why_new_for_mis: Packages multi-scale vol with an explicit fractal-chaos dimension as interpretable inputs to a transparent forecast sensor.
quote: The fractal dimension shows how "broken" the graph is: low values indicate a trend movement, high values indicate a chaotic movement.

mechanism: Compute synodic moon phase angle from currency 'birth' date; aggregate mean weekly return and |return| volatility across eight named phases over ~15y; full/new/waxing-gibbous/waning-crescent show elevated vol; feed sin/cos harmonics (1×,2×,4×) plus lags {1,2,4,8,13} into CatBoost for strong-up binary (60th pct |return|).
data_needed: Weekly OHLC from MT5; lunar_cycle=29.530588; solar_cycle=365.25636; currency birth dates; lag returns/vol.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD W1, 2010-01-04 to 2024-12-30 (~782 weeks); proposed AUDJPY etc. for higher risk-contrast.
why_new_for_mis: Calendar-phase volatility/return profile plus harmonic features as exogenous regime covariates, validated with phase-binned vol charts.
quote: Maximum volatility is observed during four phases: new moon (around 0.042), waxing gibbous (around 0.045), full moon (around 0.043), and waning crescent (around 0.041).

mechanism: CRobustScaler fits column median and IQR=Q75−Q25 then transforms (x−median)/IQR; recommended when spreads/volumes spike on news so mean/min-max scalers do not crush the bulk of the distribution.
data_needed: Numeric feature matrix (e.g. close, tick_volume, spread) with Fit on train only.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDJPY H4 pipeline demo (2999 rows ×4 raw → one-hot expanded).
why_new_for_mis: Makes outlier-heavy liquidity/vol features usable as MIS model inputs without letting news spikes dominate scaling.
quote: if we were modelling trading behaviors during a high-impact news event, where spreads and volumes can spike dramatically, then the robust scaler can be used to help preserve the central structure of the data while minimizing this anomaly influence.

mechanism: For candidate indicator pairs, align feature streams, compute mean |Kendall τ| and distance correlation; Independence = 1 − 0.5(|τ̄|+dCor̄). Rank pairs; VGT D1 5y winners: ADX–BW MFI (0.968), Gator–StdDev (0.961), FrAMA–BB (0.939).
data_needed: Paired indicator buffers on same bars; 10×10 pattern grids optional.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: VGT ETF D1, last 5 years via MT5 Python.
why_new_for_mis: Quantitative complementarity sensor that rejects redundant indicator stacks before they enter a MIS feature panel.

mechanism: Pattern A3: detect sideways via 10-bar range width below its 50-bar median; require ADX>30 with ADX.shift(5)<20; bullish if close breaks prior 10-bar high, bearish if breaks 10-bar low—paired with MFI W-shape (M5) as top UCB F1 combo on VGT.
data_needed: ADX/+DI/−DI, High/Low/Close; MFI_BW; Bayesian UCB over 10×10 pattern arms.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit compression→ADX-expansion breakout change sensor validated by independence+F1 selection on a gappy equity ETF.
quote: ADX climbing from below 20 to above 30 during sideways range -> breakout confirm.

mechanism: Native RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 + AES session-key hybrid for EA↔server secrecy without DLLs; cryptography only.
why_new_for_mis: Full read is encryption plumbing; no market sensing.
quote: RSA is rarely used to encrypt large data directly... RSA is typically combined with AES in a hybrid encryption model

mechanism: Fine-tune/in-context llama3.2:3b on balanced 24h UP/DOWN examples (M15, 96-bar horizon) for EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDCHF/USDCAD with RSI, MACD, ATR, vol_ratio, BB_position, Stoch_K; enforce chronological feature calc (iloc[:current_idx+1]) and confidence≥65% before trade.

instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDCHF, USDCAD M15; 24h hold; 30-day backtest examples.

mechanism: Map arctan-normalized features to 8-qubit RY angles, CZ-ring entanglement, 2048 shots → 256-state probs; emit Shannon entropy (high>6.5 uncertain / low<4.5 directional), max prob (dominant), count(p>0.03), and variance of state indices; feed with Fibonacci lag returns, rolling vols {5,10,20}, RSI, Bayesian hour/dow target-encoding into CatBoost.
data_needed: Feature vector (returns/vol/RSI/…); Qiskit AerSimulator; cache by MD5.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 ~15k candles; TimeSeriesSplit 5-fold ~62% accuracy reported.
why_new_for_mis: Four distribution-shape metrics that sense market uncertainty/concentration before the next bar, complementary to classical vol.
quote: High entropy (above 6.5) means the market is uncertain; low entropy (below 4.5) means the market has settled on a direction.

mechanism: Quarter-aware pipeline scores FrAMA, Parabolic SAR, Alligator Jaw/Teeth/Lips, TRIX(+signal) on XLF; labels 8-bar forward return into bearish/neutral/bullish via ±0.2% bands; train compact MLP, export ONNX; EA rebuilds identical scaled features and softmaxes logits for Long/ShortCondition.
data_needed: XLF bars from MT5; train-fit StandardScaler/MinMaxScaler params mirrored in MQL5; xlf_cls_model.onnx.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XLF ETF; validation window cited 2020-01-01..2025-12-01 (recent 20%); features from FrAMA/SAR/Alligator/TRIX.
why_new_for_mis: Regime-segmented indicator→MLP probability sensor deployed natively in MT5, aimed at surviving XLF rate/credit regime shifts.
quote: we use a quarter aware walk forward validation approach. In essence, we measure how well the model performs when forced to learn from the current regime and then predict the subsequent one.
